description: This source file implements GSM-7 and UCS-2 encoding functions for a CBS (Cell Broadcast Service) encoder, including methods for encoding messages, selecting encoding types based on data coding schemes, and packing encoded data into CB data pages.

classes.name: gsm7_char
classes.description: Structure representing a GSM-7 character with its ASCII representation, GSM-7 code, and extension table indicator.

methods.name: encode_cb_data
methods.description: Encodes a message into CB data pages based on the specified data coding scheme, choosing GSM-7 or UCS-2 encoding.

methods.name: select_cbs_encoding
methods.description: Determines the encoding type (GSM7 or UCS2) based on the data coding scheme byte.

methods.name: fill_cb_data_gsm7
methods.description: Encodes a message into GSM-7 and packs it into CB data pages, handling segmentation and padding.

methods.name: fill_cb_data_ucs2
methods.description: Encodes a message into UCS-2 and packs it into CB data pages, handling segmentation and padding.

methods.name: encode_gsm7
methods.description: Encodes an ASCII string into GSM-7 format, including extension characters, and packs bits into octets.

methods.name: encode_ucs2
methods.description: Encodes a UTF-8 string into UCS-2 (UTF-16BE) format, supporting only BMP characters.

methods.name: get_nof_gsm7_chars
methods.description: Calculates the number of GSM-7 characters needed to encode a given string, accounting for extension characters.
